# EXP Bank Calculator API

> Read-only JSON resources and typed API documentation for EXP Bank gem growth.

## When to use this API

Use these resources when an agent needs the calculator assumptions or Discord
rank thresholds. They are public, unauthenticated GET resources. Use browser
WebMCP for arbitrary calculations because GitHub Pages cannot execute
request-time code.

## Resources

- [Calculator info](https://torturado.github.io/api/info.json): rate, formula, and time normalization.
- [Calculator info Markdown](https://torturado.github.io/api/info.json.md): agent-readable mirror.
- [Rank thresholds](https://torturado.github.io/api/ranks.json): rank names and minimum balances.
- [Rank thresholds Markdown](https://torturado.github.io/api/ranks.json.md): agent-readable mirror.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://torturado.github.io/openapi.json): typed response schemas and error model.
- [Authentication](https://torturado.github.io/auth.md): access and hosting limits.
